description: FFmpegKit / ffmpeg-kit, actively maintained. Drop-in replacement for com.arthenica:ffmpeg-kit-min-gpl (Arthenica's fork, retired April 2025) -- same com.arthenica.ffmpegkit API, just change the groupId. GPL video encoders: x264, x265, xvidcore, vid.stab. No audio libs, no TLS. GPL-3.0 -- copyleft applies to your app. Android SDK 35, 16 KB page size, security-tracked. By Jokobee -- jokobee.com
